channel.title: HYT MONEY Blog
channel.description: Daily finance insights for Indian salaried professionals.

item.title: Retirement Planning: The 3-Bucket Strategy Explained
item.description: Plan a resilient retirement with the 3-bucket strategy. Learn to allocate savings for short, medium, and long-term goals, managing inflation and market volatility.

item.title: FD vs Small Savings: Compare Beyond Interest Rates
item.description: Learn to choose between FDs and small savings schemes. Discover key factors like liquidity, tax benefits, and investment limits for smart choices.

item.title: SEBI Action on Illiquid Stock Options Trading at BSE
item.description: Understand SEBI's recent action against illiquid stock options trading. Learn why liquidity matters for your investments and how to safeguard your portfolio from such risks.

item.title: SEBI Recovery Order: Investor Protection & Compliance
item.description: Learn about SEBI's recent remittance order, its role in investor protection, and practical steps Indian professionals can take to safeguard their investments.

item.title: RBI's Rural Confidence Survey: Impact on Indian Economy
item.description: Understand the RBI's Rural Consumer Confidence Survey. Learn how rural sentiment impacts India's economy and your personal finances as a salaried professional.

item.title: RBI Inflation Survey: Impact on Your Finances
item.description: Understand why the RBI's Inflation Expectations Survey matters for your salary, savings, and investments. Learn practical steps to protect your finances from rising prices.

item.title: Income Tax Refund Delayed? Check & Fix It Now
item.description: Discover why your income tax refund might be delayed and learn actionable steps to check its status, validate your bank account, and request a reissue. Get your refund sooner.

item.title: India's GDP Data: Understanding Revisions & Reality
item.description: Dive into how India's GDP figures are calculated and revised. Understand why official revisions are normal and how economic data impacts your financial outlook.

item.title: SIPs: Why Fixed Investments Miss Long-Term Goals
item.description: Learn why a flat SIP isn't enough for long-term wealth. Discover how income and inflation impact your investments and how to adjust your SIPs effectively.

item.title: Tax Regime Mistake: ITAT Gives Relief, Lessons for You
item.description: Learn how a tax filing error led to a ₹1.23 lakh demand for a Bengaluru taxpayer. Understand why verifying your ITR and tax regime choice is crucial.

item.title: Mid-cap Funds: Understanding SIP Returns and Performance Gaps
item.description: Learn why only a few mid-cap funds delivered strong SIP returns over 3 years and what this means for your investment strategy.

item.title: SEBI, ESMA Bolster Market Safety with New MoU
item.description: Understand how SEBI's agreement with ESMA strengthens the safety of your investments. Learn why global cooperation is vital for financial stability in India's markets.

item.title: AIS Expansion: GST, Overseas Investments & IT Returns
item.description: Learn how the Income Tax Department's expanded Annual Information Statement (AIS) now includes GST, foreign transactions, and off-market deals, impacting your financial reporting.

item.title: Mutual Fund NAV: Don't Let ₹10 Fool You
item.description: Understand why a mutual fund's Net Asset Value (NAV) doesn't indicate its true value or potential returns. Learn to choose funds wisely.

item.title: SEBI-ESMA MoU: Strengthening Market Safety & Stability
item.description: Learn how SEBI's MoU with ESMA on Central Counterparties enhances financial market stability and safeguards your investments in India. Understand its importance for long-term financial security.

item.title: AIS Expansion: What Indian Taxpayers Need to Know
item.description: Learn how the enhanced AIS, now including GST returns and foreign investments, impacts your tax compliance. Understand the need for accurate financial reporting.

item.title: TDS on Rent: What Tenants Paying Over ₹50,000 Need to Know
item.description: Learn about your obligation to deduct TDS on monthly rent payments exceeding ₹50,000. Understand how to comply and avoid penalties.

item.title: SEBI-ESMA MoU Strengthens Indian Market Safety
item.description: SEBI's MoU with ESMA enhances financial market stability by improving cooperation on Central Counterparties (CCPs). Discover what this means for your financial security and investments in India.

item.title: SEBI Action Against Add Life Pharma: Investor Safeguards
item.description: Learn how SEBI's decisive recovery action against Add Life Pharma Ltd protects Indian investors. Understand your rights and key steps to safeguard your hard-earned savings in the dynamic market.

item.title: SEBI Reviews Derivative Settlement Price Methodology
item.description: SEBI is reviewing derivative settlement methods. Learn what this means for your investments, portfolio transparency, and how to stay informed as a salaried professional.
